mechanism: Build downside-only loss series as max(0,-log return) over a rolling window; set POT threshold at a loss quantile (default 95%); MLE-fit GPD (xi,sigma) to exceedances with ALGLIB MinBLEIC from method-of-moments seed; report VaR_p, Expected Shortfall, and shape xi with traffic-light cutoffs (xi<0.10 calm, <0.30 moderate, else heavy). Refuse numbers below ~30 exceedances.
data_needed: Rolling window of closes (≥~800 bars at q=0.95 for ≥30 exceedances); log returns; confidence p (e.g. 0.99); optional equity budget for sizing overlay.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic liquid instruments (FX/indices/metals via tick value); demo overlay on MA-cross; lookback 800 bars any chart TF.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a live, extrapolating left-tail magnitude and heaviness sensor beyond historical VaR/ATR, with an honesty floor that blanks when the tail sample is too thin.
quote: A rising xi is the single most direct statement that tail risk is building.

mechanism: Templated CCircularBuffer<T> with O(1) Push/Get via modular head; Mean/Variance two-pass helpers; demo RollingStdDev matches built-in StdDev. Pure data-structure/performance article.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD Daily demo for StdDev cross-check; synthetic 5k-point benchmark.
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—rolling-window plumbing only.
quote: The entire performance case for the circular buffer rests on the O(n) to O(1) reduction in insertion cost

idea_name: RLS forgetting-factor slope as online trend/regime sensor
mechanism: CRLSRegression maintains θ=[intercept,slope] and 2×2 inverse covariance P; each bar applies Sherman-Morrison update with forgetting λ (effective_n=1/(1-λ)); slope histogram color flips on sign; full sign change framed as regime-shift signal; 1-step forecast ŷ=θ0+θ1·(t+1).
data_needed: Close prices vs bar time index; λ (e.g. 0.98≈50-bar effective); δ prior; min_obs warm-up.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 shown; defaults suited to daily/H1 with λ in 0.95–0.99.
why_new_for_mis: O(1) adaptive slope with continuous exponential memory (no hard window cut) yields an early acceleration/deceleration and sign-flip change sensor MIS can gate on.
quote: A full sign change — red following green or vice versa — is the model's clearest signal of a regime shift

mechanism: Embed closed-bar log returns into m-length templates; Chebyshev match within r=k·SD(window); ApEn=Phi^m(r)-Phi^{m+1}(r); color three zones (structured <low, transitional, random >high); EA gates directional entries when ApEn is below high threshold (read shift=1).
data_needed: Rolling N log returns (prefer N≥100 for m=2); m; r_factor; low/high thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 demo (N=50 and N=100 discussed); instrument/TF thresholds configurable.
why_new_for_mis: Direct serial-structure/efficiency spectrum sensor that separates volatile-but-structured from quiet-but-random regimes—usable as a MIS activity gate.
quote: Low ApEn therefore corresponds to a market that is, in the entropy sense, behaving inefficiently — exhibiting exploitable serial structure — while high ApEn corresponds to a market behaving efficiently

mechanism: Adams–MacKay recursion over run length with Normal-Gamma conjugate model of log returns (Student-t predictive); constant hazard H=1/λ; detector = posterior mass on run lengths ≤k (ShortRunMass), not raw P(r=0); also ExpectedRunLength. Consumers: monitor, self-resetting MA window flush, cooldown de-risk overlay with random-frequency control.
data_needed: Causal stream of closed-bar log returns; hazard λ (mean regime bars); RMAX; DetectK≈5; AlertLevel≈0.35; CooldownBars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 backtest and chart figures; defaults for liquid log returns.
why_new_for_mis: Causal per-bar P(regime just broke) that reacts to mean or variance breaks—fills an online change primitive beyond retrospective Chow/CUSUM.
quote: the real evidence that a regime just broke is mass PILING UP on the smallest run lengths. A spike in ShortRunMass(k) is what "a change just happened" looks like

idea_name: SAX shape-analog forward distribution with ATR outcomes
mechanism: Z-normalize window → PAA → Gaussian-breakpoint letters; MINDIST prune then Euclidean rank historical analogs with no-lookahead (outcome ends before query starts); forward paths in ATR multiples; verdict requires median |move| and directional agreement else ANALOG_NO_EDGE; fan cone only on high-conviction lean.
data_needed: Close history + ATR; window L, word w, alphabet a, horizon H; min analogs; edge ATR and up-rate thresholds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 demo (word bddcbbba, H=12); any symbol with ATR.
why_new_for_mis: Shape-only historical-analog sensor that emits an empirical forward cone and an explicit no-edge refusal—useful sequence sensing without inventing a directional oracle.
quote: On a no-edge or too-few bar, the cone is simply not drawn, and all the trader sees is the panel stating that there is nothing here.

mechanism: SFA: z-norm → low-pass DFT coeffs → MCB equi-depth letters; sliding window builds numerosity-reduced word bag; asymmetric BOSS distance (sum sq diffs over query words only); ensemble of window lengths kept by LOO≥92% of best, majority vote labels trend/range/volatile. Labels from lag-1 return ACF + relative return vol.
data_needed: Price segments (e.g. 120 bars); labeled training segments; word_len (robust=2), alphabet, window grid; ACF/vol thresholds for labeler.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSD H1 benchmark and BOSSRegime indicator; synthetic shape self-test.
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable symbolic vocabulary + multi-scale voting regime lane (trend/range/volatile) competitive with DTW and much faster—direct MIS regime tag.
quote: Two markets in the same regime speak the same dialect; two markets in different regimes do not.

mechanism: iCustom + BarsCalculated wait + CopyBuffer/CopyRates aligned locale-safe CSV for Python; EMPTY_VALUE→blank/NaN. Pipeline plumbing, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SimpleBandsDemo on ETHUSD Daily in verification screenshots.
why_new_for_mis: No sensing idea after full read—export/bridge utility only.
quote: let MQL5 compute the indicator, since that is the one place its logic is guaranteed correct, and export the resulting buffer values directly into a CSV file

mechanism: Qualify bars with volume > SMA(volume,14) using real or tick volume; HD ranks by raw volume, Normal by Δvolume; estimate long liq = low*(1-1/Leverage) on bullish bars, short liq = high*(1+1/Leverage) on bearish; extend levels until price sweeps; tier bubbles by min/avg/max of rolling signal buffer.
data_needed: OHLC + volume/tick_volume; leverage; SMA period; lookback; side filter; object caps.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol with volume; lookback default 500 bars; chart-object visualization.
why_new_for_mis: Proxy liquidity-concentration map from volume spikes and assumed leverage—MIS can sense clustered stop/liquidation magnets without exchange OI feeds.
quote: Since direct liquidation data is unavailable, the indicator uses unusually high volume as a proxy for significant market activity.

idea_name: Tsetlin Machine boolean-rule firing and conviction sensor
mechanism: Booleanize RSI/MA/ATR-high/candle bits (+internal negations); train multi-class TM with Type I/II integer feedback on ATR-scaled forward-return labels (BUY/SELL/FLAT); live panel lists ON features, firing AND-rules per class, and conviction = normalized gap of leading vs runner-up class scores (structure clarity, not a price forecast).
data_needed: RSI, fast/slow EMA, ATR, OHLC for features; labeled history with horizon and ATR threshold; saved TM CSV states.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 training/test (no OOS edge reported); chart panel on closed bars.
why_new_for_mis: White-box neural/rule sensor: readable active logic plus a conviction clarity meter MIS can use as a pattern-match confidence channel.
quote: The conviction meter is the gap between the leading class and the runner-up, normalized by the clause count. It measures how cleanly the active logic points one way versus being scattered across classes.

idea_name: Average of five swing-leg projection with ATR zones
mechanism: Confirm swings with lookback+next-candle rule; from latest pivot infer up/down structure; find six alternating pivots → five leg distances; avg_price = mean of five legs; project dashed path avg_price from latest confirmed low (up) or high (down); ATR(200) boxes as support/resistance around key swings.
data_needed: OHLC; Swing Detection Length; ATR period; projection bars ahead.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic chart TF; InpLen default 30; projection +5 bars illustrated.
why_new_for_mis: Rule-based structure size sensor that turns recent swing amplitude into a forward projection and volatility-scaled reaction zones for MIS structure context.
quote: Measures the five completed swing movements, calculates the average swing size, and applies this value to the latest confirmed swing to estimate the potential next move

mechanism: Walkthrough of breakpoints, Watch, call stack, DebugBreak on a planted buggy rolling z-score. Developer tooling only.
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—IDE debugging tutorial.
quote: the focus is the tool, not the strategy.

mechanism: Convert GPD VaR fractional loss to money via tick value/size; max_lot=(budget·equity)/LossPerLot(VaR); trade min(base,max) or skip if fit unreliable—continuous exposure lean as xi/VaR rises.
data_needed: Live EVT VaR; account equity; EquityBudgetPct; symbol tick specs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same as EVT gauge; Strategy Tester comparison with fixed entries.
why_new_for_mis: Maps tail-heaviness magnitude into a continuous risk-budget sensor for MIS exposure control rather than directional calls.
quote: Calm tail -> full base lot; fat tail -> automatically scaled down.

mechanism: On ShortRunMass≥alert, set regimeStart=current bar so adaptive mean window starts at break (capped by MaxWindow); fixed SMA keeps straddling the break—gap between curves is the regime-boundary sensor.
data_needed: Prices + BOCPD detector stream; MaxWindow; DetectK/AlertLevel.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart demo with fixed vs adaptive mean through a sharp drop.
why_new_for_mis: Turns change-point probability into an internal indicator state that refuses to average across regimes—useful MIS trend baseline.
quote: its only departure from the fixed version is that it refuses to let its window straddle a regime boundary.

mechanism: Recompute sample SD of the current return window each bar and set match tolerance r=r_factor·SD so ApEn zones stay comparable across volatility regimes and instruments.
why_new_for_mis: Makes the predictability regime reading volatility-normalized—MIS can compare ApEn across quiet/wild stretches without a fixed absolute r.
quote: Scaling r by SD normalizes the tolerance relative to the series' own dispersion, which is what makes ApEn values roughly comparable across instruments

idea_name: Readable SFA vocabulary as regime dialect fingerprint
mechanism: After BOSS bags form, print top words/counts per class; ranging markets show tight repeated vocabularies, volatile markets sprawl with little repetition—inspectable dialect of the current regime.
data_needed: Fitted BOSS bags / self-test vocabularies from segments.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic shapes and BTCUSD H1 regimes.
why_new_for_mis: Symbolic regime interpretability channel: MIS can monitor vocabulary concentration/sprawl as a readable regime fingerprint, not only a class label.
quote: a ranging market produces a small, tight vocabulary dominated by a few oscillation words; a volatile market produces a sprawling vocabulary with almost no repetition
